proposal.observation: NA-E021 (P2, rho 0.5) gave MAPE 0.0819 (parent 0.0999) but only a 42.6% fall of the P2 violation (0.836 -> 0.48). Independent review found two deviations from loss.md §4.6: physics_anchor_gradient='both' (f(x) not stop-gradiented) and f(x) / f(x_tilde) drawn with independent dropout masks — at beta = 0 the hinge is already 0.062 (0.042 on the reviewer's batch), so the term was mostly dropout-consistency noise.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: With the term implemented exactly as loss.md §4.6 (anchor sg[f(x)] and a dropout-free, identical network for f(x) and f(x_tilde)), P2 lowers the held-out P2 violation rate by >= 50% vs the parent without making MAPE worse; any MAPE change is then attributable to the voltage-sag rule.
proposal.question_inherited: Is the NA-E021 effect physics or dropout-consistency regularisation?
proposal.why_this_experiment: Implementation-fault repair of the same hypothesis (program.md §3: <= 2 repairs per mechanism). One change: compliant P2 term (anchor stop + physics_dropout_matched). rho, margin and what-if range unchanged.
proposal.modification: As NA-E021, but physics_anchor_gradient='stop' and physics_dropout_matched=true: in both the lambda calibration and the training term, f(x) (no grad) and f(x_tilde) are computed with dropout disabled. Unit test: beta = 0 gives hinge 0.000 (old setting 0.062).
proposal.held_constant_components: NA-E009 model and config, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2021 MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E009 (0.0999 / 22.5 / 0.743); P2 held-out violation rate vs NA-E009 0.836; balance band R_P2 median in [0.05, 2.0], active fraction, cosine (loss.md §5.3).
proposal.rejection_condition: DISCARD if split-2021 MAPE > 0.1049, or BALANCE_FAIL, or the P2 held-out violation rate does not fall by >= 50% vs NA-E009 (0.836). Otherwise confirm on 42/2024 and judge the 3-split mean.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
